notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): The player-facing core of Benilla's 'what am I pointing at' foundation exists in MSUI's own shape: per-frame hover pick (PickUnit - vplate rects first, then ray vs unit cylinders with world-collision occlusion test), clean world click/right-click routing (left selects/clears, right routes by classification: lootable corpse -> loot, gossip NPC -> gossip, player -> popup, hostile -> attack), and ground picking for AoE targeting (collision raycast + terrain-heightfield bisect). Benilla's inspector overlay and cast journal are dev instruments; MSUI achieves that role through its own Program.DevTools.* partials and EmitInterface evidence stream.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: MSUI picks against conservative vertical cylinders rather than actual mesh triangles; behaviorally close for units but silhouette-edge picks will differ slightly from the reference's mesh-accurate cast. Inspector/cast-journal halves are dev scaffolding (support achieved differently).
